[0m[0;32mExample: [0m[0;33mhm start phpfpm
[0m[0;32mDescription:[0m Start docker services
[0;32mOptions:
[0m   [0;33m[-s|--switch]   [0m Stop all docker container before execute start
[0;32mArguments:
[0m   [0;33m<service-name>  [0mStart specific container of the service-name.
